tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Fills only and used rarely. Play, Add, the filled part of the Listen and Your turn bar. White text on it passes 4.7 to 1.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: The only terracotta for text. The active label in the bar, the current tab, Edit, links. 7.7 to 1 on bg.

tokens.name: soft
tokens.usage: Warm grey pill. Show English, Practice again, the segmented track. Text on it uses ink.

tokens.name: current
tokens.usage: Background of the sentence you are on in the Sentences list, and the chosen language on first open.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Every screen and sheet. Warm off white. One background everywhere.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: List cards, form cards and the selected segment.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Sentences, buttons, titles and the toast. 15.1 to 1 on bg.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Pinyin, the count, English, notes, labels, inactive tabs. 5.6 to 1 on bg.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Card borders, dividers, the empty part of the bar.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: The quiet outline of Mark learned and other outline pills. Ink text inside.

tokens.name: chip
tokens.usage: Round buttons like close and back.

tokens.name: chevron
tokens.usage: Chevrons and disabled icons. 3.9 to 1 on bg.

tokens.name: warn-text
tokens.usage: The only warning colour, a true red so it never reads as terracotta. Delete sentence and Delete all sentences. 6.6 to 1 on surface.

tokens.name: backdrop
tokens.usage: Behind a sheet on phones, a warm dark grey with no brand colour. On laptops it is the same colour at 72 percent over the page.

styles.name: sentence
styles.usage: The sentence, left aligned in the middle of the screen with no card. The one thing on the screen. 56 on laptops.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Buttons, sheet titles and tab labels. Same size as body, set apart by weight only. Big type is light, small type is medium.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Nǐ jiā yǒu jǐ kǒu rén?
styles.usage: Pinyin under the sentence in muted, English in muted, setting labels, segment labels, the toast.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Mark learned when you can say it easily
styles.usage: The count, the bar labels, notes, field labels, pinyin in a list row, warnings.

styles.name: list-han
styles.usage: Characters in a list row. Chinese stays 17 so the serif strokes stay clear.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between the English line and the pinyin.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between a section label and its card, between round buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between the play row and its round buttons.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Padding inside rows and fields.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Padding inside the sentence card, above each section label, above the play row.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Side margin on every phone screen and sheet.

tokens.name: max-width
tokens.usage: Content width on laptops. SaySay stays one column everywhere.

tokens.name: radius-note
tokens.usage: The voice picker.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: The sentence card, list and form cards. Things you read.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Top corners of a sheet on phones, all corners on laptops.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, pills, the toast, round buttons. Things you tap.

tokens.name: shadow-segment
tokens.usage: The selected segment. The only shadow in the app.

tokens.name: size-play
tokens.usage: Height of the Play button. Big enough to tap without looking.

tokens.name: size-button
tokens.usage: Got it, Add and other full width buttons, and the previous and next buttons.

tokens.name: size-round
tokens.usage: Round buttons at the top, Sentences and Settings.

tokens.name: size-nav-button
tokens.usage: Round close button at the top left of a sheet.

tokens.name: size-row
tokens.usage: Minimum height of a sentence row.

tokens.name: size-card
tokens.usage: Minimum height of the sentence card, so the buttons below never move.
